verdict.rationale: Reflect ships built-in AI features (an AI palette, custom prompts, chat with filtered notes, and a GPT-4o/Claude model toggle), so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence shows it can connect to MCP servers or call external tools from its AI. Its integrations are Zapier, calendar sync, Kindle sync, deep links and a limited OAuth REST API, none of which is MCP client support.
